svg.title: Autoprompt agent hierarchy
svg.desc: The L0–L4 agent hierarchy: route selection, workers and independent checkers, with coordinators and managers for ROADMAP work.

g.text: Automatic: route analyst · Explicit: requested path
Check requirements and permissions; record the chosen route
L0 → L3 → L4 · no L1 or L2
A third worker for separate work
Short plan · no L1 or L2
Second only for a named risk
Extra checker only for a named risk
Checked output · resolved findings · saved result
